initial.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one polished photorealistic 3D browser tank game visual prototype, wide landscape 16:9. Clear varied environments: a muddy marshy green pool on left with winding drivable muddy margin, a dense stand of trees on upper left that forms impassable terrain with a clear road around, stone farmhouse ruins upper right, BREAKABLE RED BRICK garden walls with one fresh blasted opening and fragments. Both tanks leave physically plausible two parallel caterpillar tread grooves continuously behind their tracks, include one turning curve visible in muddy foreground.
